name: PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
agenda_text:
PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday NOVEMBER 12, 2020
7:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair Avery
Commissioners Fraga-Saenz, Henderson, and Smith
4. Review of Agenda
5. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
6. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
7. Consent Calendar Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of October 8, 2020.
7A
8. Public Hearings
8A. Tentative Tract Map 61940 Time Extension No. 2
G6 Planning and Design, Inc., Applicant
A request for a second and final three-year discretionary time extension to subdivide 5.49 acres into 16 lots for the purpose of constructing 15 single-family residences and one detention basin located at the northeast corner of Avenue S-8 and 42nd Street East.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt RESOLUTION NO. PC-2020-043 approving Tentative Tract Map?61940 Time Extension No. 2 and find that the project is consistent with the previously approved Mitigated Negative Declaration and Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program. Jasmine Alvarado, Assistant Planner
8A
8B. Tentative Tract Map 60500 Time Extension No. 2
LA-DF Investment Fund 78, Applicant
A request for a second and final three-year discretionary time extension to subdivide 30.45 acres into 66 lots for the purpose of constructing 65 single-family residences and one detention basin located south of Vista Point Way and west of Rancho Vista Boulevard within the Rancho Vista Specific Plan.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt RESOLUTION NO. PC-2020-044 approving Tentative Tract Map?60500 Time Extension No. 2 and find that the project is consistent with the previously approved Mitigated Negative Declaration and Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program. Jasmine Alvarado, Assistant Planner
8B
8C. Conditional Use Permit 10-007 Time Extension No. 1
Virtual Site Walk, LLC, Applicant
A request for a 10-year time extension for the continued operation of a previously approved major wireless telecommunication facility designed as a monopole and a 448 square foot equipment enclosure, located at 550?East Rancho Vista Boulevard.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt RESOLUTION NO. PC-2020-039 approving Conditional Use Permit 10-007 Time Extension No. 1 and find the project to be consistent with the previously adopted Mitigated Negative Declaration and Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program. Benjamin Fiss, Senior Planner
8C
8D. Tentative Tract Map 61894 Time Extension No. 2
Alliance Land Planning & Engineering, Applicant
A request for a second and final three-year discretionary time extension to subdivide 461.43 acres into 366 lots for the purpose of constructing 333 single-family residences, one multi-family lot, 29 open space lots, and three basins located at the southwest corner of Avenue?S and Parkwood Drive.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt RESOLUTION NO. PC-2020-040 recommending that the City Council approve Tentative Tract Map 61894 Time Extension No. 2 and find that the project will not result in any changes to the adopted EIR and Mitigated Negative Declaration and Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program. Benjamin Fiss, Senior Planner
8D
9. Staff Communications
Megan Taggart, Acting Planning Manager
10. Planning Commission Communications
11. Adjournment to the regular Planning Commission Meeting of Thursday,?December 10, 2020, at 7:00?p.m., in the City of Palmdale City Hall Council Chamber
